description: Wait until the user sends a message or an edit from the layout-debug window, then return it: the comment, the element (anchors for finding it in code) and the live-edit measurements. Returns before common tool timeouts; a timeout result is normal, call it again. Call open_window first.

timeoutSec.description: How long to wait, in seconds (default 40)

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for the next message from the window
